description.value: Peach Hill Farm Market is a family-owned orchard and roadside market in Osoyoos that has been growing and selling fresh Okanagan produce since 1996. Located on Highway 97, it offers a broad seasonal selection of tree fruits — cherries, peaches, nectarines, apricots, plums, pears, and apples — alongside melons, tomatoes, and peppers, all grown on-site by the Kaler family. It draws a loyal repeat clientele from across the valley and would make a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the South Okanagan.
